target_device_fabrication: The PCE of devices reached 18.3819%, featuring VOC of 1.05559 V, FF of 75.4007%, and JSC of 23.0952 mA/cm². The perovskite (Cs0.05MA0.16FA0.79I2.9Br0.1) solution was prepared with a concentration of 1.73 mol/L in mixed solvent of DMF and DMSO. SAM material Me-4PACz (0.33 mg/mL) was added to influence crystal growth at the interface and optimize surface passivation. The piperidinium salt MACl was dissolved in the perovskite solution obtained with the molar ratio 7.0 mg/mL. Specifically, the perovskite precursor solution was first deposited at 1000 rpm for 10 s, and then at 5000 rpm for 30 s. In the last 6 s of the second step, the antisolvent (160 µL of CB) was dropped in the center of the substrate at a constant rate within 1 s. After the spin coating was completed, it was annealed on a hot stage at 110 °C for 25 min.
